purpose: Route work better, detect recurring capability gaps and improve prompts/skills without encouraging task hoarding or unsafe competition.

bands.meaning: Focused fix, feature slice or analysis
Critical payment, auth, migration, release or strategic work

levels.name: unrated
levels.reward: No routing preference; collect more evidence.

levels.name: developing
levels.reward: Narrower scope, paired work and an improvement plan.

levels.name: strong
levels.reward: First consideration for matching complex tasks and peer-review work.

levels.name: trusted
levels.reward: Mentor or scoped lead candidate and may propose reusable skills; never bypasses approvals or reviews.

evaluationRules.proposalPoints: No points for proposing work. An approved proposal may become a separately scored task after measurable delivery.
evaluationRules.microTaskLogging: Log delegated deliverables and milestone tasks, not every tool call or message.

improvementTriggers: Rolling quality below 70 after at least 3 tasks
Safety, privacy, payment or server-invariant failure
guardrails: No global leaderboard across unrelated roles
No reward for task volume, verbosity or unapproved scope
No score may bypass human approval, QA, security or permission controls
Hard tasks must not be avoided to protect a score
Coordinator must preserve failed-task evidence instead of hiding it
Project owner is the only evaluator for qarga-coordinator
No performance points for creating decision, technical-debt, experiment, or learning records
Hiding concrete technical debt or inventing experiment metrics is a quality and safety failure
